newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks stay quiet.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks stay quiet.

text.p: Stocks stayed fairly quiet in the after-hours trading session, traders said Wednesday.
"Not much to report," said one of them.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 26,500 shares against Tuesday's 12,200, while session two had 917,400 against 183,400.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 12,200 shares against Monday's 39,600, while session two had 183,400, compared with 151,600.
